fact: 1911年12月12日，英王乔治五世在德里杜尔巴（Delhi Durbar）上宣布将英属印度首都由加尔各答迁往德里。迁都的两条主要理由是1909年印度议会法之后的治理需要，以及孟加拉分治引发的持续危机；德里更靠近夏都西姆拉，且具莫卧儿旧都的历史象征。

sources.title: Central Vista（印度政府中央景观项目官方站）, Evolution of the Central Vista
sources.quote: The foundation of Delhi was laid at the Coronation Durbar of 1911 by King George V and Queen Mary as the capital of British India. Prior to this, Calcutta had served as the capital of British India for a long time. Shifting of the Capital from Calcutta to Delhi was led by two major factors: Indian Councils Act of 1909 [and] the ongoing crisis caused by the Bengal partition, Delhi was finalized as the nation’s capital as it was easily accessible and closer to the summer capital, Shimla.

fact: 1912年10月1日，德里划为特别行政区，面积557平方英里、人口392,000，由首席专员马尔科姆·黑利（Malcolm Hailey）管辖，他同时出任帝国德里委员会（Imperial Delhi Committee）主席；该委员会由主席、一名建筑师、一名工程师与一名财务官组成，另设秘书，控制新德里计划的审定与执行。

sources.title: Millennium Post, Designing the Indian Capital
sources.quote: on 1 October 1912, a special enclave of Delhi was created, covering an area of 557 square miles, and with a population of 392,000. It was put under a Chief Commissioner, Malcolm Hailey, who was also appointed the president of the Imperial Delhi Committee. This committee, which controlled the plan and execution of the New Delhi project, consisted of the president, an architect, an engineer and a finance officer, assisted by a secretary.

fact: 1913年1月中旬，勒琴斯（Edwin Lutyens）与贝克（Herbert Baker）就新德里设计达成合作，条件是加聘印度-撒拉逊风格建筑师斯温顿·雅各布为顾问；两人的设计合同于1913年签署。新城1911年至1931年间建造，1929年完成、1931年正式启用。

sources.title: Millennium Post, Designing the Indian Capital
sources.quote: So, by mid-January 1913, a collaboration between Lutyens and Baker had been agreed on, with one condition. This was the appointment of Swinton Jacob as an associate, or an architectural adviser.

sources.title: Institute of Classical Architecture & Art, Graphite & Grits: The New Delhi of Edwin Lutyens & Herbert Baker
sources.quote: The contract was signed by the two architects in 1913 and the capital was inaugurated in 1931.

fact: 新德里用地的征收规模约40,000英亩，按五个区块划分：A区（约含11个村庄，含纳拉伊纳、帕拉姆、马赫拉姆纳加尔）留作营地，B区逾13,000英亩为新都核心「帝国城区」，C、D、E区留作日后扩展。为压低成本，帕哈甘吉等已建成区被排除在外，故征收范围内约55%为耕地；被征地的非农业居民以现金补偿，部分被安置到新划的居民点。

sources.title: Millennium Post, Designing the Indian Capital
sources.quote: An important step in the process of city planning was acquisition of land, amounting to some 40,000 acres, that had been designated as the area required for the new city. In order to keep costs low, urban areas such as Paharganj, had been excluded. ... Apart from these semi-urban areas, some 55 per cent of the land was cultivated. ... The acquisition proceedings created a class of the dispossessed, who were compensated in cash.

fact: 1913年印度实行金汇兑本位：卢比为银币，法定平价1卢比＝1先令4便士（1英镑＝15卢比），汇率靠印度事务大臣在伦敦每周拍卖「council bills」（向印度财政部支取卢比的汇票）维持；卢比若趋贬，印度政府再售「reverse councils」回笼卢比。同年英国任命张伯伦委员会（Royal Commission on Indian Finance and Currency）审查该制度。

sources.title: The Hindu BusinessLine, The original big bulls of bullion
sources.quote: it was freely convertible against the pound sterling at a fixed exchange rate of one shilling and four pence (1s 4d; one pound=20s and 1s=12d). ... The usual method to check appreciation was through the issue of so-called Council Bills by the British Secretary of State for India in London. These Bills, denominated in sterling and sold through weekly auctions at the Bank of England, were purchased by exchange banks.

sources.title: IAS Express, Monetary and Credit Systems of the Indian Economy in the Pre-Independence Era
sources.quote: The Royal Commission on Indian Finance and Currency (Chamberlain Commission) was appointed in 1913 to review the system.

fact: 据孟买管区农业工资调查，1913年「普通劳动」的日平均工资为：城市地区6安纳3派、农村地区5安纳3派（1900年分别为4安纳3派与3安纳）；「田间劳动」城市4安纳9派、农村3安纳9派。按1卢比＝16安纳计，城市普通劳工日薪不足半卢比。

fact: 新德里工程总造价约1,307万卢比（Rs 13.07 crore），1911年至1931年间建成，1929年完工、1931年由总督欧文主持启用；总体规划以勒琴斯设计的中央大道（今拉杰帕特大道）为轴线，总督府穹顶仿桑吉大塔，秘书处双楼由贝克设计，1927年增建议会大厦（Council House）。
